data.name: Drisvika
data.gender_notes: Drisvika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Drisvika is a Sanskrit name derived from the root 'dris' meaning 'roar' and 'vika' meaning 'strength'. This name symbolizes the powerful roar of Goddess Durga, who is revered for her fearlessness and strength. The name Drisvika carries the meaning “Goddess Durga's roar” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Drisvika usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess durga's roar and live with faith, good character and purpose.
